question: Where can I find a golf course inside 150 kilometers from City Suites Hotel, Chicago, IL?
sql: WITH hotel_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%City Suites Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chicago%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT poi_name AS golf_course_name FROM pois WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM hotel_location)::geography, 150000) UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS golf_course_name FROM parks WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_DWithin(geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM hotel_location)::geography, 150000);

answers.golf_course_name: Hickory Knolls Golf Range & Mini Putt
